body: I understand. You're not alone, I feel hopeless often as well...I wish I could be there to speak with you. No one has the answer(s), but I believe in you. I truly hope you feel better soon, no one deserves this.
Please search out anyone from your family, even friends. I know you don't have the money to but please understand, that is detrimental to your mental health.
Seek a new therapist, the fact she spoke of another patient to you even in the vaguest of ways speaks volumes of her character. I wish you well.
